title: LEE ENTERPRISES, Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-07
summary: Lee Enterprises, a newspaper publishing company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its April 6, 2026 annual stockholders meeting. Stockholders elected two directors, approved executive compensation, approved an amendment to the Long-Term Incentive Plan, and ratified BDO USA as the independent auditor. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Lee Enterprises held its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders on April 6, 2026.
Stockholders elected Ronald J. Kruszewski and Madeline E. McIntosh as directors for three-year terms expiring at the 2029 annual meeting.
A non-binding advisory vote to approve executive compensation received 18,798,111 votes for, representing strong stockholder support.
Stockholders ratified the appointment of BDO USA, P.C. as the company's independent registered public accounting firm.
As of the March 2, 2026 record date, there were 22,229,939 shares of common stock outstanding.
88.68% of outstanding shares were present at the meeting, constituting a quorum.
